desc: 圆领短袖T恤配松紧腰工装短裤，一套穿好男童夏日街头造型
leaf: 男童短袖T恤迷彩工装短裤两件套
name: 男童潮酷短袖两件套夏装款

shots.intent: 搜索列表里一眼看清是一套衣服而不是单件T恤，抢点击率并满足白底主图合规。
一秒法则：把套装最大差异点（后背大面积图案与宽松版型）在首屏海报里直接讲完。
shots.textZone: right third inside the accent block #F0D800: headline at the top of the block, one support line below it

shots.intent: 让家长代入孩子穿这一套出门的状态，用街头道具把版型与活动量讲清楚。
用三处做工特写解释结构与穿着舒适度，替家长回答耐穿好不好洗这类疑问。
shots.textZone: one label line centered under each of the three panels

shots.intent: 微距证明织面与印染边界的真实质感，替代源图里无法核实的面料话术。
同一屏看全两个配色与正反面，让颜色与款式选择一步到位，降低退换率。
shots.textZone: one column label above each column, one color chip beneath each column

shots.intent: 把选码与洗涤方式结构化说清，消掉买大买小和怎么洗的最后顾虑。
shots.textZone: right column holds the grid title line and the measurement rows, bottom band holds the row of thin-line care icons

shots.intent: 收掉风险：用可替换的资质位与做工承诺位给出信任，但不编造任何检测结论。
shots.textZone: upper-right headline with an accent underline, one short label line beneath the accent underline

shots.intent: 详情页最后一步收口，用套装组合感与按钮把浏览转成下单动作。
shots.textZone: clean headline field above the set, rounded CTA button below the headline inside the accent block

style.backgroundSystem: seamless studio sweep #FFFFFF for packshots and variant flat lays, concrete-tone panel #E4E4DF for benefit and trust screens, matte info panel #F5F5F2 for spec and detail screens, outdoor asphalt #4C4C4A only for the lifestyle scene; one flat accent block #F0D800 may carry a headline, one block per screen
style.direction: street-smart kids apparel commerce, editorial energy with clean infographic discipline
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons in #1F1F1F for care, spec and proof labels, no filled emblems, no certificate artwork, no seal realism
style.lightingSystem: daylight-balanced 5500-5600K key from the upper left, softbox diffusion with a bounce fill on the shadow side, true contact shadow under every hem, raking side light on texture screens, no harsh speculars, no dramatic falloff
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent street-smart children's apparel visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless studio background #FFFFFF, label ink #1F1F1F, printed-fabric surface #5A6B47 used only inside garment artwork, and one accent #F0D800; daylight-balanced 5500-5600K lighting with an upper-left softbox key, bounce fill and true contact shadows; one modern geometric sans-serif plus one bold condensed display weight for headline blocks only; background system of paper sweep #FFFFFF, concrete panel #E4E4DF, matte info panel #F5F5F2 and asphalt #4C4C4A for the lifestyle screen; thin single-weight line icon style in #1F1F1F; garments always presented as one matching set with stable scale and flat unwrinkled surfaces; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no color palette changes and no new accent colors
no mixed fonts and no handwritten or retro lettering
no random backgrounds or stock-photo interiors
no inconsistent lighting direction or missing contact shadows
no mismatched icon styles and no invented badge artwork
no adult or teen model proportions on children's garments
style.presentationRules: the top and bottom piece always read as one set with the same scale across screens; garment silhouettes fully visible on light screens, mid-shot crop allowed on benefit and spec screens; consistent slight 3/4 or straight-on product attitude, head cropped out whenever a frame is worn
style.surfaceSystem: matte paper sweep #FFFFFF, concrete step #E4E4DF, asphalt ground #4C4C4A, printed fabric field #5A6B47 only inside garment artwork areas; surfaces stay unwrinkled and free of debris
style.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif for all Chinese and Latin labels, plus one bold condensed display weight reserved for headline blocks; Chinese copy always rendered as 「{selling_point_N}」/「{callout_N}」; headline 28-48pt, subline 16-20pt, label 10-14pt, per-screen copy budget under 50 characters
